metadata.title: That one kill where I swear I was just guessing... and somehow won VALORANT
metadata.description:
Wait, did I just get a kill by accident?
My brain was AFK but the game said yes.
Watch me fake confidence like it was all planned.
Valorant logic: ‘How did that even land?’

Click if your best kills were total flukes!

#valorant #luckygamer #funnyclips #gamingfails #shorts
